stem: According to the source, what is the most important and easiest clinical sign to demonstrate when examining an infant for DDH?
explanation: This sign is highlighted as the most important clinical feature because it is the most straightforward to demonstrate during a physical exam.
rationale: This sign involves testing the range of motion of the hip while the knees are flexed.

optionExplanations.A: Measuring leg length is noted to be very difficult and unreliable in infants.
optionExplanations.B: While plagiocephaly is a sign of fetal packing, it is a secondary feature rather than the primary hip examination sign.
optionExplanations.C: This sign is highlighted as the most important clinical feature because it is the most straightforward to demonstrate during a physical exam.
optionExplanations.D: Groin creases can be indicative of a problem, but they are not considered the most reliable or easiest sign compared to range of motion.

source.hint: This sign involves testing the range of motion of the hip while the knees are flexed.
